title: "Community - Bestiary"
format: html

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Total kills

```{r}
#| warning: false

library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(dplyr)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "../../asset/demonax-test.sqlite")
players <- dbReadTable(con, "players")
daily_snapshots <- dbReadTable(con, "daily_snapshots")
daily_bestiary <- dbReadTable(con, "daily_bestiary")
creatures <- dbReadTable(con, "creatures")
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)

# Get latest snapshot date
latest_date <- max(daily_snapshots$snapshot_date)

# Get latest snapshots
latest_snapshots <- daily_snapshots |>
  filter(snapshot_date == latest_date)

# Get kill counts aggregated by creature
# First get total kills per creature
creature_totals <- daily_bestiary |>
  inner_join(latest_snapshots, by = c("snapshot_id" = "id")) |>
  filter(!player_id %in% c(100001, 100004)) |>
  left_join(creatures, by = c("monster_id" = "race")) |>
  group_by(monster_id, creature_name = name) |>
  summarize(total_kills = sum(kill_count), .groups = "drop")

# Get top killer for each creature
top_killers <- daily_bestiary |>
  inner_join(latest_snapshots, by = c("snapshot_id" = "id")) |>
  left_join(players, by = c("player_id" = "id")) |>
  filter(!player_id %in% c(100001, 100004)) |>
  group_by(monster_id) |>
  slice_max(kill_count, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    top_killer = paste0(
      '<a href="/qmd/characters/', player_id, '.html" ',
      'style="color: #004294; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 500;">',
      name,
      '</a> (', kill_count, ')'
    )
  ) |>
  select(monster_id, top_killer)

# Combine and arrange before formatting
bestiary_lb <- creature_totals |>
  left_join(top_killers, by = "monster_id") |>
  arrange(desc(total_kills)) |>
  mutate(
    creature_slug = gsub("^_|_$", "", gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "_", tolower(creature_name))),
    Image = paste0('<img src="../../asset/img/outfit/', monster_id, '.png" width="32" height="32" />'),
    Creature = paste0(
      '<a href="/qmd/creatures/', creature_slug, '.html" ',
      'style="color: #004294; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 500;">',
      tools::toTitleCase(creature_name),
      '</a>'
    ),
    `Total kills` = format(total_kills, big.mark = ","),
    `Leader (Total kills)` = top_killer
  ) |>
  select(Image, Creature, `Total kills`, `Leader (Total kills)`)

DT::datatable(bestiary_lb,
          options = list(
            pageLength = 25,
            searching = TRUE,
            ordering = TRUE
          ),
          rownames = FALSE,
          escape = FALSE)
```

### Leaderboard

```{r}
#| warning: false

top_hunters <- daily_bestiary |>
  inner_join(latest_snapshots, by = c("snapshot_id" = "id")) |>
  left_join(players, by = c("player_id" = "id")) |>
  filter(!player_id %in% c(100001, 100004)) |>
  group_by(player_id, name) |>
  summarize(
    total_kills = sum(kill_count),
    unique_kills = n_distinct(monster_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(total_kills)) |>
  mutate(
    Rank = row_number(),
    Name = paste0(
      '<a href="/qmd/characters/', player_id, '.html" ',
      'style="color: #004294; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 500;">',
      name,
      '</a>'
    ),
    `Total kills` = format(total_kills, big.mark = ","),
    `Unique kills` = unique_kills
  ) |>
  select(Rank, Name, `Total kills`, `Unique kills`)

DT::datatable(top_hunters,
          options = list(
            pageLength = 20,
            searching = FALSE,
            ordering = TRUE,
            columnDefs = list(
              list(className = 'dt-left', targets = 0)  # Rank column
            )
          ),
          rownames = FALSE,
          escape = FALSE)
```
